name: The Library of Babel
blurb: Every possible page of text, already written. Search any sentence and find the exact page where it lives.

what: The site is built on Jorge Luis Borges’s 1941 short story about an endless library holding every book that could ever be written. Jonathan Basile turned the idea into a website: an algorithm that can produce every possible page of letters, spaces and punctuation, each with its own fixed address.
Most pages are noise. Somewhere in the noise is every sentence anyone has written or ever will. That thought is the hook.
start: Use the search page and jump to the shelf where it already exists.
Browse rooms, walls and shelves at random and read a few pages.
Borges’s original is short, and it changes how the site feels.
guide.why: Every search works, and every result feels like proof of something impossible. Then you start wondering whether a page you haven’t searched for might mean something.

name: Radio Garden
blurb: Spin a globe and tune into live local radio from almost any city on Earth.

name: WindowSwap
blurb: Look out a stranger’s window somewhere in the world, with the sound on.

name: The Deep Sea
blurb: Scroll down through the ocean, meter by meter, and meet what lives at each depth.

name: The Scale of the Universe
blurb: Zoom from the smallest known things to the size of the observable universe.

name: Little Alchemy 2
blurb: Start with four elements, combine them, and try to discover everything.

name: Infinite Craft
blurb: Mix words into new things. Water plus fire, then keep going forever.

name: Zoom Quilt
blurb: A hand-painted image that zooms into itself and never ends.

name: The Useless Web
blurb: One button that sends you to a random, gloriously pointless website.

name: GeoGuessr
blurb: Dropped somewhere on Street View. Work out where you are from the clues.

name: SCP Foundation

name: Pointer Pointer
blurb: Move your mouse, and a photo appears of someone pointing right at it.

name: Eel Slap
blurb: Drag your mouse. A man gets slapped by an eel. That’s it, and it’s perfect.

name: Find the Invisible Cow
blurb: Hunt for a hidden cow using only sound. Gets louder as you get closer.

name: Koalas to the Max
blurb: Hover over circles that split into smaller circles until a picture appears.

name: Weave Silk

name: Explorable Explanations

name: This Person Does Not Exist
blurb: Refresh to see a face generated by AI. None of them are real people.

name: Hacker Typer

name: Staggering Beauty

name: Wayback Machine

name: Space Jam (1996)
blurb: The original movie website, still online and nearly untouched since the 90s.

name: Cameron’s World

name: The Million Dollar Homepage

name: Project Gutenberg
blurb: Tens of thousands of free public-domain books to read in your browser.

name: OoCities

name: Old Time Radio

name: MarineTraffic

name: Zooniverse
